House Bill 998 (RULES COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) (AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE) By: Representatives Leverett of the 123rd, Camp of the 135th, Powell of the 33rd, Jasperse of the 11th, Williams of the 168th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 4 of Chapter 5 … of the Universal Access Fund, so long as such information does not disclose any trade secret or proprietary information of any specific provider."
SECTION 4. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
